values.name: Product Review
values.description: A 16:9 YouTube review (4-20 min) of one product - what it is, how it's built, how it does, who it's for - calm, exact and honest.

music.notes: Minimal ambient electronic (music-library: Electronic / Calm, Electronic / Chill Dreamy) low under the talk, fading in and out over 2 s [EDS]; up in b-roll montages, out under the verdict.

look.about: Neutral and exact - the product's real colours, a touch of contrast and nothing more [EDS no heavy grading, the product must look accurate].

values.label: Product review
values.summary: A clean tech-style review - the product and one opinion up front, design to verdict in clear parts, spec cards, close detail shots, true colour.

credits.source: Original preview imagery; hands, objects, places and titles only
credits.licence: Original letitedit footage: hands, objects, places and titles only; no faces

title.about: The product's name and the question the review answers, after the cold open (an intro of 3-5 s) [EDS].

rules.when: Once, after the hero shot and the first opinion (params title, subtitle).

spec_card.about: One white card with at most four facts (price, what's in the box, size, the key spec), on screen 4 s or more [PND one card of at most 4 bullets about 20 s in; EDS specs visible at least 4 s].

rules.when: Early (about 20 s in) when the facts are said; exact values as recorded; params title, items, times.

section.about: The part of the review on a band (Design, Fit, Performance, Verdict) as it starts [EDS design to verdict].

rules.when: Each part's first shot, matching the chapter markers; params number, title.

part_label.about: A small label naming a part on screen ("Metal tabs", "Reversible leads"), white with a dark edge.

rules.when: A part or a feature the viewer must recognise, as it is shown; six words at most, exact names; give asset {text}.

detail_push.about: A slow push into a close-up of the product (108% over 2.5 s).

rules.when: Close detail shots of the product (texture, ports, parts) [EDS include close-up detail shots]; not on the speaker.

verdict_card.about: Pros and cons on one white card (green ticks, red crosses) as the verdict starts.

rules.when: At the verdict; items as {text, mark - check or cross} in the reviewer's own words; a score only when the reviewer gives one.

credit_tag.about: A small dark tag naming where a borrowed clip or image comes from [PND a credit tag on every borrowed clip].

rules.when: Over any footage the reviewer didn't film (params text, e.g. "Footage - maker's site"); only footage they may use.

cutaway.about: Close-up b-roll of the product over the voice.

rules.when: About as much b-roll as talking head [PND 43% b-roll, 48% talking head]; never over the verdict.

fx.rhythm: Talk and close-up b-roll taking turns every 8-10 s at most [EDS]; one spec card early, one verdict card late.

hook.rules: A hero shot of the product and one key opinion first [EDS]; the thesis within about 2-3 s, under 10 s at most [PND]; then a brief intro of 3-5 s [EDS]. The ending - the verdict held on one shot, speech ending 4-6 s before the video does, no long subscribe ask [PND, EDS].

provenance.measured: none yet (no reference videos in style-references)

sources.title: EditStyle tech review preset
sources.used_for: constant energy, jump cuts, no speed ramps, neutral accurate colour, design-to-verdict parts, specs visible at least 4 s, cold open with the product and an opinion, 3-5 s intro, talk and b-roll taking turns every 8-10 s, music low with 2 s fades
sources.licence: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Minseo; preset credited CutAI Community (consulted only; no text adapted)

sources.title: PandaStudio measured analysis of a tech reviewer (3 videos)
sources.used_for: about 7 cuts a minute, median shot 4-7 s, busy first 30 s, 43% b-roll, one spec card of at most 4 bullets, credit tags, a held verdict, no burned-in captions, thesis by about 2.4 s
sources.licence: none found (numbers only; the reviewer is not named in the pack)

provenance.notes: The measured numbers come from three videos of one channel; tune them on the person's references. EditStyle's own numbers disagree with each other (10 cuts a minute vs a 5 s average). Tags in ..\SOURCES.md.
